summary: A Yes vote increases the transient occupancy (hotel) tax in the unincorporated area of Yolo County from 8% to 12%, with revenue going to the county general fund.

tax.text: A Yes vote supports raising Yolo County’s transient occupancy tax from 8% to 12% to help fund county services.
tax.quote: A “yes” vote on Measure X approves Ordinance No. 1585 and the proposed increase in the TOT from 8% to 12%.

tax.text: A no vote would reject increasing the transient occupancy tax from 8% to 12%, leaving the rate at 8%.
tax.quote: A “no” vote on Measure X is a vote against authorizing the proposed changes in Ordinance No. 1585 and the TOT rate would remain at 8%.
